checks: Extensions opens the Python package manager in its dedicated work surface
The bundled package inventory and filtering show actual installed distribution metadata
Install requirements creates .venv and installs the declared offline wheel through actual pip with visible output
The normal Python run plan imports the package from the environment prepared in Extensions
Invalid pip options are rejected and the form displays the real validation error

Returning to VSIX extensions retains the project source and the existing extension catalog
packageSource: Explicit offline verification wheel; real pip and interpreter, no simulated package installation.
